lines.zh: 我压着步子，沿着河岸走。
lines.en: I walk the riverbank with heavy steps.

lines.zh: 两条后腿撑起这具身体。
lines.en: Two hind legs carry this body.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，草就伏下一片。
lines.en: Each step lays a patch of grass flat.
I keep my head low and sniff as I move.
I head toward the water.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后缓慢摆动。
lines.en: My tail swings slowly behind me.
I stride across a gully.
I press away toward the trees.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧过来，过窄道。
lines.en: I turn sideways through a narrow gap.
I stop and look up.
I start walking again.
I walk over to that stretch of sand.

lines.zh: 我踩在湿泥上，印子很深。
lines.en: My prints sink deep in the wet mud.

lines.zh: 我沿着自己的旧路走回去。
lines.en: I follow my own old route back.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近那片空地。
lines.en: I close on that clearing step by step.

lines.zh: 我的下颚半张，牙露出来。
lines.en: My jaw hangs half open with teeth showing.

lines.zh: 风把气味送过来，我闻了闻。
lines.en: The wind brings scent and I sniff.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一棵断树。
lines.en: I hold still like a broken tree.
I move one foot forward.
A low sound rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 我的影子很长，盖住了草。
lines.en: My shadow is long and covers the grass.
I close my jaws slowly.
Grazers lie far off; I do not stir.

lines.zh: 我张嘴咬断一根低枝，嚼也没嚼。
lines.en: I bite a low branch in half and do not even chew it.
I tip my head up at the sky.
I turn a small arc on the spot.
I sweep my tail once.
I wait for them to come closer.
I turn my head square to you.
I lower myself and lean in.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，把你的味道记下。
lines.en: I sniff and store your scent.
My teeth are right in front of you.
You draw off and I do not follow.

lines.zh: 我偏着头，一只眼对着你。
lines.en: I tilt my head, one eye on you.
Your hands are moving.
I open and close my jaws once.
Standing like that is a little interesting.
A roar rolls up from my throat.
That tears the hide on my back.
I shake the blood off.
The more it hurts, the harder I bite.
I press my weight down.
I grit my teeth and stay up.
I pant out hot breath.

lines.zh: 我记得这一下是谁给的。
lines.en: I remember who gave me that.
These two legs can still run.
I lift my head up.

lines.zh: 肉味一飘来，我就转头了。
lines.en: The smell of meat turns my head.

lines.zh: 你举起来的东西，一口就没了。
lines.en: What you lift is gone in one bite.
That portion is too small.
I come closer with a light tread.
I lower my head to sniff your hand.
Be still; I may not stop myself.
I chew twice and swallow.
I want the big pieces.
My tongue sweeps across my lips.
That only starts the appetite.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，我几乎不动。
lines.en: You hit my leg and I barely move.

lines.zh: 我肩头一送，你退了半步。
lines.en: One nudge of my shoulder and you give back.
This weight will not be shoved.
I look down, fangs bared.
You back off fast, which is sensible.
I lift a foot to a new spot.
The impact booms in my chest.
Walking against my leg is too close.
Stop running into me.
We circle one another.
It lowers its head to my neck.
Two bodies press tight.
I push a low branch aside for it.
It moves off and I follow.
We lie abreast in the shade.
I lay my head on its back.
We circle the same ground.
Neither of us is in a hurry.

lines.zh: 我咬住一大块，甩了两下。
lines.en: I take a big piece and shake it twice.
That bite went clean through.
I swallow it whole.
Too small to bother with.
I hold it under one foot.
I taste it and spit it out.
I carry it a few paces.
My mouth is all blood.
This piece I keep for later.

lines.zh: 我把它从骨头边撕下来。
lines.en: I tear it off the bone.
It barely stirs and I have seen it.
I lower my head and aim.
One bound takes me out.
At this range, one lunge is enough.
I stare at it hard.
My teeth clack together.

lines.zh: 它往那边跑，那里没出路。
lines.en: It runs that way and there is no way out.
I begin the chase.
I cut toward its flank.
It has stepped into my ground.
I growl and the grass lies flat.
It is already panting.

lines.zh: 我跟着它，步子越拉越长。
lines.en: I follow, my strides stretching out.
It turns and I cut inside.
I hold its rear quarter.

lines.zh: 我算它的速度再压上去。
lines.en: I measure its pace and close.
My teeth line up like a saw blade.

lines.zh: 它每一次回头我都记着。
lines.en: I mark each time it looks back.
It dives into the trees, which is better.
I bite the gap shorter and shorter.
It is slowing.
One more beat and I drive.
I know this ground better.
Its shadow has touched mine.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，牙陷进去。
lines.en: I bite down and my teeth sink in.
I butt with my brow.

lines.zh: 一只脚踩下去，地面裂开。
lines.en: One foot comes down and the ground cracks.
I knock it over.
That bite tears a piece off.

lines.zh: 它咬来，我一甩头把它撂倒。
lines.en: It bites and one shake brings it down.
I clamp its shoulder again.
I press it into the earth.
I pant with something still in my jaws.
It pulls away and I do not chase far.
That blow emptied me.
I lift my head and blood drips down.
I step out of the treeline and the ground jumps.
The river is right before me.

lines.zh: 我一现身，近处活物全僵。
lines.en: The moment I appear, nearby life freezes.
I raise my head and sweep a look.
I snap a few dead branches.
The wind brings scents and I note them.
I head toward the water sound.
The sand here is soft.
My shadow reaches far.
I growl low in my throat.

lines.zh: 我落脚的地方草全断了。
lines.en: Grass snaps where I set down.
I start along the river.
It has just rained here.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的背，我翻滚压灭。
lines.en: Fire sears my back and I roll to smother it.
I land too hard and my bones rattle.
Water floods my throat and I jerk up.
The blast shoves me a step sideways.
Something buries in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 怪力钻进骨头，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Strange force seeps into my bones and I shudder.
Too long without food and my strength ebbs.

lines.zh: 雷顺着脊背走，腿都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning runs my spine and my legs go numb.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，这具身子往下坠。
lines.en: The ground is gone and my bulk drops.
